topics.titleTr: Küçük Siteler İçin A/B Testi ve CRO
topics.titleEn: A/B Testing and CRO for Small Sites
topics.angle: guide + optimize conversions with low traffic
topics.brief: Question-driven CRO guide for low-traffic sites. Sections: when you have too little traffic for classic A/B and what to do instead; prioritizing tests (ICE/PIE); what to test (headline, CTA, form, social proof); avoiding peeking and false wins; qualitative signals (heatmaps, session replays, surveys); tools on a small budget. Verify: minimum-sample and statistical-significance basics, plus low-traffic alternatives (sequential testing, qualitative). Sources: CRO guides; experimentation-stats primers. End with a test-prioritization worksheet. Distinct from landing-page-conversion-mistakes.

topics.titleTr: Senin Yerine İş Yapan AI: Ajan Eylemleri
topics.titleEn: AI That Books and Buys: Agentic Actions Arrive
topics.angle: deep-dive + what it means when AI completes real-world tasks
topics.brief: Question-driven consumer explainer. Sections: what 'agentic actions' means (AI completing real tasks, not just chatting); examples—ChatGPT restaurant reservations via OpenTable/Resy/Yelp, bookings and forms; how it works under the hood (tools/connectors); trust, confirmation and failure modes; what is safe to delegate and what isn't; where this heads next. Verify: ChatGPT reservation search via OpenTable/Resy/Yelp (2026) and agentic capabilities moving into ChatGPT/Codex after Atlas's shutdown. Sources: OpenAI release notes; tech coverage. End with a delegate-this-not-that list. Distinct from agentic-browsers-comparison.

topics.titleTr: AI Ses Kaydediciler ve Not Cihazları 2026
topics.titleEn: AI Voice Recorders and Note Gadgets in 2026
topics.angle: comparison + should you buy a dedicated AI note device?
topics.brief: Data-led gadget comparison. Sections: what these do (capture, transcribe, summarize, sync); Plaud NotePin and rivals; phone apps vs dedicated hardware; accuracy and languages (including Turkish); privacy of cloud transcription; battery and workflow fit; who should buy one vs just use an app. Verify: Plaud NotePin positioning in 2026 and on-device vs cloud transcription tradeoffs. Sources: gadget reviews; product pages. End with a buyer's matrix and a privacy caveat. Distinct from ai-meeting-assistants-compared, which covers software.

topics.titleEn: Protect Your Privacy in the Age of AI Assistants
topics.angle: checklist + lock down what AI assistants know about you
topics.brief: Field-notes privacy checklist. Sections: what AI assistants store (chats, memory, connected data, computer history); training opt-outs and data controls per tool; connected apps and least-privilege; sensitive data you should never paste; enterprise vs consumer data handling; kids and family accounts; a periodic privacy audit. Verify: 2026 memory/training-control settings across Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini and ChatGPT Computer History being opt-in. Sources: vendor privacy and data-control docs. End with a step-by-step privacy checklist. Distinct from the chatgpt-computer-history how-to.

topics.titleTr: Churn'ü Azalt: Küçük SaaS İçin Elde Tutma
topics.titleEn: Reduce Churn: A Retention Playbook for Small SaaS
topics.angle: checklist + the levers that keep customers from leaving
topics.brief: Data-led retention checklist. Sections: measuring churn right (logo vs revenue, cohort curves); onboarding as the number-one retention lever; activation moments and time-to-value; usage signals and at-risk alerts; win-back and cancellation flows; pricing/packaging churn; expansion and NRR basics. Verify: retention benchmarks, the onboarding-to-retention link and the NRR definition. Sources: SaaS-metrics guides; retention studies. End with a retention checklist and a churn-diagnosis flow. Distinct from saas-metrics-founders, which defines the metrics.

topics.angle: guide + position before you write a word of copy
topics.brief: Story-led positioning guide. Sections: positioning before copywriting (who it's for, the alternative you replace); finding a differentiated value; the homepage message hierarchy; features vs outcomes; proof and objection handling; naming the category; testing messaging with real prospects; using AI to draft variations you then cut. Verify: positioning frameworks (April Dunford-style) and homepage-messaging best practices. Sources: positioning and messaging guides. End with a positioning worksheet and a homepage message template. Distinct from pricing-saas-product and marketing-funnel posts.
